relations.subject: Zhou Zumo
relations.evidence: In 1932 he entered the Department of Chinese Language and Literature at the National Peking University and studied phonology under Luo Changpei (1899–1958).

relations.subject: Zhou Zumo
relations.evidence: Later, he taught for a considerable period in the Department of Chinese Literature (Guówén xì 国文系) at Fu Jen Catholic University
